name: Gidyy
source:
Main character here is left totally alone in this world with the death of his grandfather. But among his grandpa's belongings he finds a time machine and gets back in time to conquer hearts of the most famous girls in world history.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-december-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
祖父去世后，主人公在世上再也没有任何亲人。然而，他从祖父的遗物中发现了一台时间机器，于是回到过去，准备征服世界历史上最著名的女性们。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-december-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
